summary: Full backend+frontend verification of the new iteration features (Psychologist role, Admin Team+per-user tab access, Billing Reports+CSV export, Forms upload+external URL). Backend pytest: 74/74 passed. UI E2E via Playwright: all critical flows pass — psych sidebar restricted to 5 tabs, /patients shows no-access for psych, biller Reports page renders all summary/filter/chart/export controls and totals populate ($1235.00), doctor cannot see reports/team, admin can create user->grant reports tab->delete user, receptionist can upload PDF (download-form-<id> appears) and create external URL form (open-link-<id> appears).
ui_flows_verified: Psychologist login -> sidebar shows only Dashboard/Appointments/Telehealth/Notes/Messages (5 tabs). /patients renders data-testid=no-access.
Biller Reports: nav-reports opens, cards report-{totalBilled,collected,outstanding,invoicesLabel} render, date filter apply-filter-btn works, export-csv-btn present.
Doctor does NOT see nav-reports or nav-team.
Admin Team: add-user-btn -> uf-name/email/password/role -> save-user-btn creates user; edit-tabs-<id> opens checklist; tab-reports toggle + save-tabs-btn persists; delete-user-<id> removes user.

Receptionist Forms: add-form-btn with ff-url shows open-link-<id> action after save. upload-form-btn -> uplf-title + uplf-file (PDF) + save-upload-btn -> new row appears with download-form-<id> action.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 780 lines — long overdue to split into routers (auth, patients, appointments, notes, invoices, cpt, forms, reports, messages, team). Not blocking, but maintainability is degrading each iteration.
Billing report /api/reports/billing loads up to 2000 invoices and aggregates in Python. Fine for now but consider MongoDB aggregation pipeline once dataset grows (>10k invoices).

GET /api/forms/{id}/download and /api/reports/billing/export both accept a JWT via ?auth= query param — this token can leak via server access logs / browser referer. Acceptable for internal-only downloads/exports but worth noting; a short-lived signed URL would be safer.
put_object exception path in POST /api/forms/upload swallows original error (returns generic 502). Consider logging exception once at ERROR and preserving the message for admins.
Frontend Layout.js hardcodes ALL_TABS in nav[]; when the backend ALL_TABS grows, the frontend needs a matching entry. Consider driving the nav from /api/meta/tabs for admins.
